name: evsoc_smart_ed451
description: smart fortwo electric drive (451, 3rd generation, 2012-2016): listening on the vehicle CAN at OBD pins 6/14 (500 kbit/s). Displayed state of charge from frame 0x518, last byte / 2; BMS state of charge from 0x2D5, 10 bit (byte 5 bits 1-0 and byte 6) / 10. After OVMS vehicle_smarted (MIT), confirmed there with example frames. Experimental: not checked by evsoc on any car.
verified: no (experimental; example frames from the OVMS source)
